# Learned instinct: gitlab-sast-secret-detection-included (confidence 0.9)

The GitLab Security/SAST and Security/Secret-Detection pipeline templates must be included in `.gitlab-ci.yml`. This is the CI-layer backstop that catches secrets before they reach a merge. The pre-commit gitleaks hook is developer- side; the CI gate is authoritative. Both must be active.

Source: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 6.3.2; GitLab Security Scanning docs
